title: CLASS: A Controller-Centric Layout Synthesizer for Dynamic Quantum Circuits
problem: Traditional quantum layout synthesis focuses on circuit depth optimization; ignores classical controller communication time, critical for Dynamic Quantum Circuits with runtime measurements and conditional operations.
motivation: Dynamic quantum circuits require controller-to-controller communication optimization beyond traditional device-centric depth minimization.
method: Hypergraph-based modeling of distributed control system; heuristic-based graph partitioning algorithm optimizes controller communication latency.
key_novelty: First controller-centric layout synthesizer addressing inter-controller communication in distributed quantum control systems.
contributions: Controller-centric design methodology for DQC layout
Hypergraph-based modeling of distributed control systems
Up to 100% communication latency reduction with only 2.10% avg operation increase

metrics.ppa: 100% communication latency reduction possible, 2.10% avg operation increase

limitations: Assumes distributed control model; doesn't optimize circuit depth; quantum-specific; scalability unknown.
